newsitem.title: FRANCE: MATIF announces four new yield spread contracts.
newsitem.headline: MATIF announces four new yield spread contracts.

text.p: French futures and options exchange Matif SA said on Friday it would launch four new long-term yield spread contracts on Globex on May 30.

The contracts will be based on benchmarks as close as possible to 10 years for the yield spreads: OAT/Bund (France/Germany), BTP/Bund (Italy/Germany), Obligaciones/Bund (Spain/Germany) and T-Note/Bund (U.S./Germany), it said.
MATIF also said it planned to add quickly a range of other long-term yield spread contracts based on French government bonds (OATs).

MATIF said from the launch of European monetary union, scheduled for Janaury 1, 1999, the long-term yield spread contracts would continue to trade as yield spreads would still exist between bonds issued by different states.
